target_customer: Teams running high-risk workloads such as custodians, fintech, blockchain, AI and regulated data collaboration that need proof of what code runs in production
problem: Confidential computing hardware exists but tooling is fragmented; attestation proves a binary hash, not which source produced it, and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack.
business_model: Hosting platform with bring your own compute and managed hosting; open source platform dual licensed AGPL-3.0 and commercial

founders.name: Anton Livaja
founders.background_notes: YC page cites work with BitGo, Ledn, Turnkey, OpenZeppelin and Unit 410 among clients.

founders.name: Ksenia Lesko
founders.background_notes: Ran strategy and ops at Distrust and led customer education and activation at Ada, per the YC page.

founders.name: Lance Vick
founders.background_notes: Former security lead at those firms, per the YC page.

competitors.what: Open attested confidential compute platform with GPU TEE support and a Trust Center
competitors.traction_then: Active launcher through 2025 per its own posts

competitors.what: Confidential compute on AWS Nitro Enclaves with reproducible Blue Images

competitors.name: AWS Nitro Enclaves
competitors.what: Cloud provider enclave primitive that Caution builds on

technical_complexity.rationale: Reproducible enclave image builds, attestation tied to source, and multi-hardware support (Nitro now, TDX, SEV-SNP and TPM later) require specialist security engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Deep reproducible build expertise from Distrust and Stagex is hard to copy, but the platform is fully open source and the TEE vendors and crypto-native rivals overlap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals were shipping attested TEE hosting in 2025; no incumbent action against Caution recorded.

market_need_then: Verifiable compute demand from crypto, AI and regulated data; founders cite years of consulting for custodians and others on systems securing more than $600 billion in assets (company claim).

identity.voice_and_tone: Security-first and adversarial: Confidential compute you can verify, not trust

branding.brand_signature: Verify, not trust; echoes the parent consultancy name Distrust
branding.community_and_virality: Open source code on Codeberg and an early access registration code system; no merch or fan activity found.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive real word and a message consistent with the Distrust lineage, but no independent press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Caution is an active Summer 2026 company spun out of the Distrust security consultancy, launching an open source verifiable hosting platform in early access on AWS Nitro. Strong founder market fit and technical depth are positives, while open source licensing, crypto-native rivals and cloud providers cap defensibility, and no funding is public.

Education for founders not found. Competitor dates are vendor blog dates. Completeness pass: the 125K seed is recorded from Dealroom alone (single database); date unknown, and the amount matches YC standard terms.
